record_title: Dimension-amplified logarithmic endpoint failure for the strong maximal operator
provenance: An n-parameter and all-p extension of the explicit mass-recurrence obstruction introduced by Lerner in arXiv:2609.14008v1, compared against the all-p all-dimensional upper-bound framework of Ombrosi and Rey, arXiv:2609.17246v1.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The two closest preprints were submitted in September 2026, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The result gives a logarithmic improvement over the endpoint lower power but does not determine the optimal power exponent, gives no matching upper logarithmic factor, and does not address the weighted weak-type norm. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
